jm.pageTitle: Jusmundi — 4 Years Key Achievements & KPIs | Alban Andrieu
jm.heroSubtitle: Key KPIs & Achievements (2022–2025) · Highlighting my work as DevSecOps and colleagues' work & impactful contributions
jm.securityBandHeading: Security-first — anti-scraping, Keycloak identity and authorization, no friction for legitimate customers
jm.securityBandLead: Primary focus on security: protecting the business from abusive scraping and delivering robust identity and authorization with Keycloak—without slowing down or blocking legitimate customers, partners, or approved crawlers.
securityBand: Scraping and abuse — Cloudflare WAF, rate limits, and bot controls tuned so real users and whitelisted SEO tools keep working while automated scraping drops sharply.
Keycloak — SSO, API gateway authentication for microservices, HA across regions, and policies (2FA, brute-force protection) aligned with the product experience.
Legitimate access — changes rolled out with monitoring so security hardening does not degrade trust or conversion for paying users.
jm.infraBandHeading: Migrating infrastructure to a state-of-the-art Kubernetes in the US with network refunding
jm.infraBandLead: US hosting and platform refresh: DNS, Kubernetes, and network modernisation—moving from Nomad to Kubernetes with cost optimisation and a clearer path for regional scale.
infraBand: Kubernetes migration — assessment, cluster design, and rollout aligned with product availability and release cadence.
US footprint — hosting and connectivity choices that support latency, compliance, and operational ownership across teams.
Network — Magic WAN, VPC peering, VPN, and Cloudflare WARP so offices and cloud environments stay reachable and observable.
jm.aiBandHeading: Supporting business and tech through the transition to an AI company — hosting tuned legal models with ...
jm.aiBandLead: Transitioning to AI: hosting legal models, keeping infra compliant, and supporting team adaptation.
aiBand: AI model hosting — legal AI models deployed on elastic, reliable infrastructure.
Compliance — maintained ISO 42001, SOC 2 across new workloads.
Collaboration — supported teams to adopt new analytics and hosted legal tools.
jm.achievementsSubtitle: Security, reliability, and platform delivery (2022–2025) - My main focus : ensuring the platform is secure, reliable and delivering the product

seo.title: SEO improvements
seo.lead: WAF and crawler policy tuned for search visibility
bullets: Anti-scraping and WAF implementation tuned to preserve SEO: legitimate crawlers whitelisted (AhRefs, SemRush, Oncrawl, Google Analytics, etc.).
WAF behaviour and SEO impact monitored throughout rollout; bot traffic reduced by ~75% without impacting real users or search visibility.
SEO drop issues investigated and addressed; since AI bots shift, SEO has been stable and improved over the years.

sla.title: SLA & reliability improvements
bullets: Alerts based on SLAs for critical services; SLO-based alerting for availability monitoring.
Platform availability maintained at 99.9%+ for critical legal research; target 99.9% uptime for core services.
MTTR reduced from hours to minutes (P1 ~30 min average) through observability and runbooks.
Alert noise reduced by ~60% via intelligent filtering.

security.title: Security & compliance
security.lead: Vulnerability management, IdP SSO, and certifications
vulnBullets: Vulnerability remediation target: <7 days for critical CVEs; container scan pass rate >95%.
Vulnerability management: weekly vulnerability scanning and remediation of critical vulnerabilities. Using OpenVAS, Trivy and Semgrep.
Semgrep SAST, GitLeaks secret scanning, Mega-Linter and GitLab Ultima Sec for code security.
Implement Cloudflare WAF and DDoS protection for the website, rate limiting and bot detection.
Use Vault for secrets management, secret rotation, certificate automation and in transit encryption for user documents
idpBullets: Keycloak authentication modernisation: migrated from legacy auth and upgraded through 4 major versions.
SSO integration with Microsoft Entra ID and other internal services; 2FA and brute-force protection enabled.
Keycloak in HA mode; token expiration and high-latency incidents resolved in production, and across multiple regions.
Use of Keycloak in API Gateway mode for authentication and authorization of microservices.
complianceBullets: ISO 27001 preparation and support; Server hardening and firewall reviews.
Platform aligned with SOC II certifications achieved by Jusmundi.
First IA Tech implementing and maintaining ISO 42001 compliant security frameworks for IA.
Annual firewall reviews, access control, and EDR/XDR agents on new servers.

platform.title: Platform & infrastructure
platform.lead: Cloud, data, CI/CD, and AI platform foundations
bullets: Infrastructure migration assessment, US hosting (DNS, Kubernetes, network), cost optimisation and Kubernetes migration from Nomad to Kubernetes.
Observability: Victoria Metrics, Loki, Grafana dashboards, DataDog APM and tracing across services.
Network: Migration to Magic WAN, VPC peering and VPN and Cloudflare WARP.
Database: PostgreSQL tuning, autovacuum and cache hit improvements; 20+ critical disk-space incidents resolved.
Jus AI support: Elasticsearch clusters, GPU nodes, assistant and document-classification services.
CI/CD: pipelines optimised, automated with templating, container scanning, code linting; Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and Ansible) with ~90% reduction in manual configuration errors.

jm.overallHeading: Overall estimate of people to Support, my Boss an entry level and I
overallBullets: The largest departments are Revenue/Sales, Tech (30%), and Marketing/Product
